text:
lina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on last night's outage. Root cause: cloud auth latency spike led to token refresh storm; model-registry overloaded; serving retries amplified load. Need concrete owners, deadlines, and quick mitigations.

omar: I'll take gateway-level changes. Plan: add exponential backoff w/ decorrelated jitter, install a circuit breaker that trips after 5 consecutive 5xx to fail fast to cache. Draft PR by Mon EOD.

sophia: I'll own model-registry side. Short term: keep serving on cached tokens if provider returns 5xx for token endpoint, add metrics: refresh_rate, refresh_errors, refresh_latency_p50/p95. Target: staging by Thu.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INC-5229 "token-refresh amplification -> model-registry overload". Linked to incident runbook and assigned temp owner: lina. DR test planned 2027-04-10 14:00 UTC.

vince: I'll open a support case with the cloud provider, request detailed auth endpoint logs and latency histograms, and ask for SLA impact assessment. Will post case number + summary by Tue.

lina: Short mitigation to deploy today: reduce gateway retry max_attempts to 2 for auth failures, add 500ms base backoff + jitter, and add an opt-in global token-refresh rate limiter (token-bucket) at the registry client. Can someone push that patch?

omar: I can push gateway retry change now; will also wire the circuit-breaker feature flagged off by default.

sophia: I'll add the client-side token-bucket throttle (default 1rps per replica) and expose override via config.

lina: Action list (assigning owners and dates):
- A1 (omar): Gateway backoff + circuit-breaker + prod rollout behind FF. PR by Mon 2027-03-29, prod behind canary 2027-04-01.
- A2 (sophia): Model-registry cached-token fallback + metrics + dashboard. Staging 2027-03-31, prod 2027-04-07.
- A3 (vince): Cloud provider support case + retrieval of auth logs + vendor playbook update. Case # and doc by Tue 2027-03-30.
- A4 (infra-bot): Schedule DR + runbook snippet for manual switch to long-lived fallback tokens. DR 2027-04-10.
- A5 (lina): Create CI e2e that simulates auth latency and validates fallbacks + add it to our nightly smoke. Test in CI by 2027-04-05.

omar: I'll include an automated canary for gateway changes (5% traffic) and rollback job.

vince: Cloud support replied that they observed a spike at 2027-03-27T02:12Z and are providing a trace sample. They've tentatively offered a partial credit pending internal review. I'll paste logs in the ticket.

infra-bot: INC-5229 updated: owners set (omar,sophia,vince,lina), due dates added, DR link attached.

sophia: Added Grafana dashboard panel links: /dashboards/token-refresh and /dashboards/auth-latency. Alert: when refresh_errors > 0.2% for 10m -> P1.

lina: We noticed this pattern 3 times this year. Proposal: weekly "dependency resilience" 30-min sync for next 8 weeks to review vendor behavior, playbook changes, and rotate the owner. Volunteers?

vince: I'll take the first rotation.

omar: I'll take the second.

sophia: I'll do third rotation and then we'll iterate.

lina: Perfect. Please post short status updates here: e.g., "omar: PR merged", "sophia: staging metrics live", "vince: support case #12345". We'll close when all prod changes are verified and DR passes. :white_check_mark:
